select i0.id as itemId, i0.name, m.description as mdescription, i0.specification, i0.classification, i1.f_000070, i1.f_000142, i1.f_000147, CA.description as adescription, CB.description as bdescription, i0.f_000181, i0.isbommodified, i0.guid, i0.updatetime as iupdatetime from ITEM_0 i0 inner join ITEM_1 i1 on i0.guid = i1.foundationfk inner join MA_CLASS m ON m.guid = i0.classguid inner join MA_CODE_DETAIL CA ON i1.f_000072 = CA.guid inner join MA_CODE_DETAIL CB ON i1.f_000145 = CB.guid where i0.latestrevision LIKE 'm%'
and i0.id = #{itemId}
and i0.specification like '%' || #{specification} || '%'
and i1.f_000070 like '%' || #{f000070} || '%'
and i1.f_000147 like '%' || #{f000147} || '%'
and (i0.classification = #{classification} or i0.classification in( select mcd.guid from MA_CLASSIFICATION_DETAIL mcd where mcd.parentguid=#{classification}))
order by itemId
